# DEMOCRACY Deutschland – Project Conventions

Details and reasons: `AGENTS.md`.

- **1:1 markup**: section components reproduce the DOM of the original templates _after_ the jQuery init functions, with the original classes, ids and inline styles. Styling comes only from the original CSS in `public/css/` (never edited); no Tailwind, CSS modules or new global CSS.
- **Pages** (`src/app/(site)/**/page.tsx`) are thin shells around `<MdxPage id="…" />`; text and section order live in `content/pages/<id>.mdx`.
- **Blog** (`/blog/`, WordPress theme Lovecraft): own root layout in `src/app/(blog)/blog/[[...path]]`, components in `src/components/blog/`, logic in `src/lib/blog/`. Posts in `content/blog/` are generated by `pnpm import-blog`; never edit them or the theme CSS by hand. Archives, feeds (`…/feed/index.html` route handlers) and the search index are built from them; the search (`/blog/?s=`) and the short links (`?p=`) run on the client (`BlogSearch`, `BlogQueryScript`). `/blogseite/` shows the blog in an iframe. Verify with `pnpm compare /blog/…`, `pnpm compare-blog-dom`, `pnpm compare-blog-feed` and `pnpm compare-blog-search`.
- **Routing**: every path and old state is in `content/site/routes.yaml`; internal links use the new paths with trailing slash through `Link` from `src/components/shared/Link`. Raw asset URLs use `asset()`.
- **Legacy URLs**: old paths outside the hash router are rules in `src/lib/legacy-paths.ts`; the same data drives the client redirect (`resolveLegacyUrl()`, also on the 404 page) and `out/.htaccess` (`buildHtaccess()`, Plesk). Every kind of old URL has an example in `tests/legacy-urls.ts`, tested by Playwright (with and without basePath) and `pnpm check-htaccess`.
- **Interactions** in React without jQuery; jQuery timings via `src/lib/animate.ts`. Bootstrap 4.0.0 plugins are ported in `src/lib/` (`bootstrap-collapse.ts`, `bootstrap-modal.ts`, `bootstrap-tooltip.ts` with Popper.js 1.12.9 like live).
- **Schemas**: every content type has a Zod schema in `src/lib/schemas/`; run `pnpm validate-content`.
- **Static export**: no middleware, server actions or dynamic API routes. Files the old site generated (the app JSON `/api.php`) are static `GET` route handlers with `dynamic = "force-static"`. Server needs go into `docs/server-funktionen.md`.
- **SAI/database data** (donation status, team, press media, FAQ, roadmap) lives in YAML under `content/`; blog posts are Markdown files with inline HTML in `content/blog/` (read via `src/lib/content/blog.ts`); values PHP computed use the PHP-compatible helpers in `src/lib/donation.ts`.
- **Forms** (contact, bug report, volunteer): checks and alert texts 1:1 via `runChecks()` and `content/site/forms.yaml`; sending with `sendForm()` from `src/lib/forms.ts` to `NEXT_PUBLIC_<FORM>_ENDPOINT` or a prefilled `mailto:` (no alert, no reset after the mailto). There is no upload server: the bug report has no file picker, a notice (MDX props `attachMailto`/`attachEndpoint`) asks for screenshots by mail.
- **Legal texts** (Impressum, Datenschutz, Nutzungsbedingungen) are plain Markdown in `content/legal/`, HTML only where Markdown cannot reproduce the live layout; never change their wording (a test compares them with the saved live responses).
- **Verification**: `pnpm compare <path>` against live plus Playwright tests for every interaction; deviations into `docs/abweichungen.md`. Never send a form or upload a file on live; scripts against live block `api.php?call=send_mail|upload` and stub `sendMail`, `$.ajax` and `XMLHttpRequest` first.
